scope_boundary: Gate C adjudicates only engineering implementation and preregistration constraint satisfaction
Gate C does NOT adjudicate whether the framework possesses autonomous mathematical discovery capability
Gate C PASS does not imply the preregistration is approved
note: C1-C5 is a NEW candidate standard proposed 2026-10-10. It must not be represented as a standard that already existed in r2.

domains.name: execution_path_integrity
domains.question: Do the official entry points use the designated shared r2 scorer, and is there any scoring bypass?
pass_conditions: official CLI and test entry points reach the same scoring path
shared scorer bindings as expected; required object-identity assertions pass
no legacy scoring bypass able to affect official results
fail_conditions: test and official runs use different scoring logic

domains.name: scoring_and_fail_closed
domains.question: Are malformed responses, missing dependencies and termination states handled per spec?
pass_conditions: invalid, truncated, malformed and missing-field responses classified per preregistered semantics
termination-state priority and MODEL_NONCOMPLIANCE counting semantics correct
missing required dependency fails explicitly, never silently skipped
model calls blocked when not authorised

domains.name: preregistration_semantic_consistency
domains.question: Do Markdown, JSON and actual execution obey one set of key constraints?
pass_conditions: Markdown and JSON agree on no-rejudge, no-overwrite, no-core semantics, termination-state priority, aggregation rules, field semantics
executing code does not violate those constraints
round-1 historical material used only for the authorised integrity purpose, never as capability evidence
fail_conditions: any key constraint missing, conflicting, or bypassed at execution time

domains.name: release_and_evidence_integrity
domains.question: Do tested code, version identity, hash manifest and test results point to one fixed version?
pass_conditions: a single tested commit or immutable archive is identified
hash-manifest scope is explicit and computed values agree
test logs correspond to that version and to the actual execution
third-party report separates tested, untested and evidence sources
fail_conditions: report does not match executed artefacts

domains.name: contract_and_metadata_consistency
domains.question: Do the declared versions, counts, paths and claims match the actual content?
pass_conditions: declared file counts, hash-entry counts and version identifiers match actual content
derived information is generated from the data source or automatically cross-checked, not maintained as unrelated hand-written constants
document revision and package revision are distinguishable
fail_conditions: incorrect key metadata in the document
automation claims inconsistent with the actual mechanism

process.name: lock_tested_version_and_evidence
stop: evidence cannot be tied to one fixed version

process.name: evidence_mapping_and_gap_analysis
output: PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/N/A per clause with evidence references
process.rule: reuse sufficient evidence first; do not re-run passing tests

process.name: execute_gap_tests
process.rule: only items lacking evidence, or affected by defects or code revisions

process.name: independent_review_and_single_ruling
process.rule: summary PASS must never substitute for per-item evidence

frozen_rules: no post-hoc standard change: implementation may be fixed, the acceptance condition may not be back-edited
no silent skip: missing required dependency, test or assertion must not yield overall PASS
no unfounded re-run: reuse evidence while code and dependencies are unchanged
no converting failure into unscorable: NONCOMPLIANCE, termination state, missing field and invalid response count per fixed semantics
no unauthorised model calls: engineering acceptance requires none; calls remain zero
record untested items separately: neither auto-PASS nor auto-FAIL without a contractual basis

PASS.gate: may proceed if other required items satisfied

FAIL.action: register defect, locate cause, fix, targeted test plus regression
FAIL.gate: may not pass the affected gate

BLOCKED.action: name missing evidence, permission or environment; resume after unblocking

N/A.gate: only if contract allows and approval is valid

INCONCLUSIVE.meaning: executed but result cannot distinguish conformance from non-conformance
INCONCLUSIVE.action: improve measurement or test method; stay undecided

definition: historical material used for forbidden re-judgement or capability evidence
Critical.action: stop acceptance immediately; re-review all affected clauses after fixing

Major.action: blocks Gate C; targeted test and necessary regression after fixing

definition: documentation or naming issue that does not change execution semantics or evidence validity
Minor.action: record per contract, fix within deadline; blocking status must be decided in advance, never by the executor

decision_table.condition: contract approved and any required item FAIL
contract approved and any item undecided (BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE)
contract approved and all required items PASS

two_independent_decisions.case: Gate C PASS but capacity calibration, budget freeze or k-fixing incomplete
two_independent_decisions.ruling: Gate C PASS, preregistration still NOT APPROVED
fix the defects; a preregistration approval condition must not be used to mask engineering failure
resolve only the blocking evidence; do not write uncertainty as pass or failure

two_independent_decisions.case: both Gate C and preregistration approval pass
two_independent_decisions.ruling: only permission to work under the preregistered plan; it still does not demonstrate autonomous mathematical discovery capability

execution_decision: freeze this candidate acceptance standard and submit it for authorised review
retain the passing r2 engineering evidence; do not re-run unnecessary tests
handle D-007: produce a new revision with count generation and a negative-control test
after approval, map existing evidence and run gap tests only for uncovered clauses
output the formal ruling record with per-item results, evidence references, open issues, exception approvals and signatories
review preregistration approval conditions separately; never treat the Gate C outcome as proof they are satisfied

notes: correct hashes do not imply correct count declarations
